The category values are the plan's table, still a draft until Sapega answers the chart picture. Each category has one exact height: art_px; world_px = art_px x 1.5. The tolerance is only the rounding: +-1 art px (1.5 world px). Plane factor rule: on a Parallax2D plane the target is round(art_px x scroll_scale.x) art px, then x1.5. Measured: the opaque bbox of the drawn frame, feet on its bottom row. The hero's drawn figure (opaque rows 10..56 of Idle/2.png) is 47 art px; it is not the unit. Categories are tried in this order; the first whose keyword is a whole token of the object's node name, scene path or texture paths wins (tokens: CamelCase and snake_case split, a trailing s/es allowed). art_px null: no chart value (monsters keep their D560 size classes).
